facts.text: Deborah organized a yoga event that included food stalls and live music.

evidence.quote: I reached out to different nearby businesses and places to make it happen. We had yoga, food stalls, and even some live music - it was amazing!
Organizing a yoga event last month was really cool.

facts.text: Deborah mentioned that balancing hobbies and studies involves prioritizing and managing time effectively.

evidence.quote: As for balancing hobbies and studies, I find it helpful to prioritize and manage my time effectively. Making a schedule and setting aside specific time for studying and pursuing hobbies can go a long way in maintaining balance.
Any tips for maintaining a balance between hobbies and studies?

facts.text: Jolene recommended several video games, including Zelda BOTW for Switch, Animal Crossing: New Horizons, and Overcooked 2.

evidence.quote: I have a few game recommendations. Zelda BOTW for Switch is an awesome open-world game. Animal Crossing: New Horizons is really calming and cute.
Cool recs! I'll definitely check those out. What about your favorite memories of playing video games?
Oh, I forgot to mention Overcooked 2 - this is a good co-op game if you're into hilarious and chaotic cooking.

facts.text: Jolene mentioned that she and her partner often play Overcooked 2 for bets and have won three large pizzas.

evidence.quote: My partner and I often play for bets! I once won three large pizzas!
